messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: The treatment involved an 80 mg IV bolus.
This was followed by a continuous infusion of 8 mg/hr for 3 days.
After this period, therapy may be continued with an oral PPI.
Triplet: ["Pantoprazole", "has dose", "80 mg"]

The relation 'has dose' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is administered at the dose specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
B. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
C. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
D. 'dose adjustment responsibility': The entity specified by the object is responsible for making changes to the dose of the subject drug.
E. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
